resources.string: No app on this device can open that.
A coding agent that runs on your phone. Setup takes a few minutes, and most of it happens on its own.
Open a folder from the sidebar to start your first chat.
Connect a model in Settings → Providers before your first chat.
Pipkin\'s agent runs inside Termux, a terminal app for Android. Get it from F-Droid or Google Play, then come back. We recommend the F-Droid version for the best user experience.
Pipkin\'s agent runs inside Termux, a terminal app for Android. Get it from F-Droid, then come back.
This copy of Termux isn\'t from F-Droid or Google Play, so Pipkin won\'t use it. Uninstalling it deletes Termux\'s files.
Pipkin only supports signed F-Droid and Google Play versions of Termux for your safety.
This Termux is older than Pipkin supports.
Termux %1$s from Google Play is installed.
Pipkin starts by sending commands to Termux.
Android won\'t ask again. In settings:\n\nPermissions\u00A0→ Additional\u00A0permissions\u00A0→ Run\u00A0commands\u00A0in\u00A0Termux\u00A0environment\u00A0→ Allow
Pipkin can run commands in Termux.
Paste the setup command into Termux.
Android may sometimes kill large pkg installs during setup. If this happens, please retry the command. It picks up where it left off.
Termux was reinstalled, which removed Pipkin\'s setup, the agent and its sign-in. Paste the command again.
Pipkin notifies you when a chat finishes or needs your answer while you\'re away.
Android won\'t ask again. In settings, turn on All\u00A0Pipkin\u00A0notifications.
Keeps a chat going while the screen is off or you\'re in another app. Without it, Android can cut the agent off mid-task. When Android asks, tap Allow.
Pipkin can run in the background.
Let Termux run in the background
The agent runs inside Termux. Without this, Android can stop Termux to save battery and cut a chat off mid-task. When Android asks, tap Allow.
The agent runs inside Termux. Without this, Android can stop Termux to save battery and cut a chat off mid-task. In Termux\'s battery settings:\n\nAllow\u00A0background\u00A0usage\u00A0→ Unrestricted
Samsung: Battery\u00A0→ Unrestricted\nXiaomi: Battery\u00A0saver\u00A0→ No\u00A0restrictions\nOnePlus, Oppo, Realme: Battery\u00A0usage\u00A0→ Allow\u00A0background\u00A0activity
Termux can run in the background.
Needed to work on files outside Termux, such as in Downloads or Documents. When Termux asks, tap Allow.
Needed to work on files outside Termux, such as in Downloads or Documents. In All\u00A0files\u00A0access, turn on Allow\u00A0access\u00A0to\u00A0manage\u00A0all\u00A0files for Termux.
Pipkin installs its agent, Pi %1$s, in Termux. It takes a few minutes.
Pipkin\'s helper didn\'t start in Termux. Paste the setup command again.
Sign in with a subscription or add an API key. You can add more in Settings later.
Available once the agent is installed.
